_published_faq.name: How do I add Upwork to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Upwork to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.upwork.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Upwork MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, Upwork scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Upwork MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upwork lists 46 MCP tools, including upwork__boost_profile, upwork__confirm_attachment_upload, upwork__confirm_draft, upwork__end_contract, upwork__find_freelancers, upwork__find_jobs, upwork__find_saved_jobs, upwork__get_account, upwork__get_agency, upwork__get_agency_dashboard, upwork__get_client_dashboard, and upwork__get_client_financials.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Upwork?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Upwork in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Upwork requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Why is Upwork failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upwork scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is Authenticated MCP access is available. Reconnect the server account or provide a valid refreshable OAuth session, then rerun the audit. Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Upwork is developed by Upwork. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
